verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's core product is a browser-based cloud Editor requiring a live session (docs-24, docs-25), and community reports confirm there's no easy offline/local dev workflow for Editor-hosted projects (playcanvas-comm-8, playcanvas-comm-11, playcanvas-comm-12). However, the standalone open-source Engine can be scaffolded with Vite/TypeScript via `create-playcanvas` and built like any npm project (playcanvas-docs-1, playcanvas-docs-7, playcanvas-gh-2, playcanvas-gh-4), and an Editor REST/scripting API exists for automation (playcanvas-docs-9, playcanvas-docs-27, playcanvas-docs-30), giving a partial path to headless builds outside the Editor UI. Missing for 10: an official documented CLI/CI pipeline for building and exporting Editor-hosted projects headlessly, and no evidence resolving the community-reported lack of local/offline dev for cloud projects.
